TAB Windsday Ride

Sylvania, OH · Road · Gravel

TAB Windsday Ride is a road and gravel group ride in Sylvania, OH. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:30 pm from Pacesetter Park. Pace: road B (19–21 mph); gravel C/D (16–20 mph).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19–21 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the TAB Windsday Ride group ride

The Toledo club's midweek ride with both a road group and a gravel group. Routes change and get posted on the club's Facebook page. Helmets required, no earbuds.
